correctness.rationale: PASS. For S_m=conv(e_i), Haar discarded k-plane of H_m is represented by centered m-by-k Gaussian rows; pairwise discarded squared edge length is (Z_i-Z_j)^T(Z^T C Z)^{-1}(Z_i-Z_j). Since every simplex diameter is realized by a vertex pair, Delta²=2-min discarded square. Wishart Frobenius second-moment bound gives spectral uniform replacement by |Z_i-Z_j|²/m because k~c log m. Each pair distance is 2 chi²_k, rate I(s)=(s−1−log s)/2. Counting m² pairs yields threshold c I(s)=2; the second-moment lower side handles dependent overlapping pairs with Chernoff q<=exp(-k J(s)) and exact identity 4(J−3I/2)=H(s)>0. Independent sympy log algebra verified identity and H'(s)=−(1−s)²(s+3)/[s(3−s)(1+s)]<0 for 0<s<1. Therefore k^{-1} min pair distances -> 2s_c and (m/k)(sqrt2−Delta)->s_c/sqrt2, where s_c−1−log s_c=4/c. No fixed-k/linear-k or CLT claim.

Second-moment overlap inequality, not independence of all m choose 2 pair distances, is essential; Gaussian rows are independent but distances sharing a row are not.
